memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity.
Evidence: BMI 34.2 kg/m2, waist circumference 112 cm, weight 87 kg.
Symptoms and examination: Patient reports fatigue on exertion, mild knee discomfort, no dyspnea. General appearance obese, blood pressure 138/82, pulse 78, respiratory rate 16, SpO2 98% room air. Cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal.
Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0.
Plan: Lifestyle modification, start orlistat 120 mg with each main meal, order fasting lipid profile, glucose, HbA1c, LFT, repeat waist in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting lipid profile: Total cholesterol 6.2 mmol/L (ref <5.2), LDL 4.1 mmol/L (<2.6), HDL 0.9 mmol/L (>1.0), triglycerides 2.3 mmol/L (<1.7).
Fasting glucose: 6.1 mmol/L (3.9-5.5).
HbA1c: 6.2% (4.0-5.6).
Liver function: ALT 38 U/L (<40), AST 34 U/L (<40), ALP 78 U/L (<120), GGT 45 U/L (<51), bilirubin 12 µmol/L (<21).
Waist circumference: 112 cm.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Orlistat 120 mg capsule – take one capsule with breakfast, lunch and dinner. Continue for 3 months, review then.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity.
Evidence: Weight 84 kg (down 3 kg), BMI 33.0, waist 108 cm.
Symptoms and examination: Reports occasional oily spotting after meals, otherwise tolerating medication well. No new joint pain. BP 134/80, pulse 76, respiratory 15, SpO2 99%.
Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0.
Inhaler: none prescribed, technique not applicable.
Plan: Continue orlistat, reinforce low-fat diet, repeat labs in 6 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity.
Evidence: Weight 82 kg, BMI 32.2, waist 105 cm.
Symptoms and examination: Minimal GI side effects, reports improved energy, knee pain less. BP 130/78, pulse 74, SpO2 99%.
Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0.
Inhaler: none, technique not applicable.
Assessment: Good response to orlistat, lipids improved.
Plan: Continue orlistat, add vitamin D 800 IU daily, repeat labs in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Discontinue orlistat due to persistent oily stools despite low‑fat diet. Stop effective today. Continue vitamin D 800 IU daily.

Plan: Restart orlistat after dietary counselling, emphasize <30% fat intake, review in 4 weeks.
